items.note: Detecting copied runtime context/guidance needs the injected context text as a fingerprint; no kind compares changed files against runtime-context content.

sources.quote: Do not copy runtime context or operation guidance into implementation files or planning artifacts

items.note: Whether a capability name names an implementation task or a proposal section is a semantic judgment; the kebab-case forms of section names are not literal in the source, so a disjoint cross_ref cannot be grounded.

sources.quote: Do not name implementation tasks or proposal sections.
Use kebab-case for path segments you introduce (e.g., user-auth or identity/user-auth) ... - `<capability-path>`: <brief description of what this capability covers>

items.note: Would need a selector of capability paths existing under openspec/specs/ at BASE_SHA (base_paths gives file paths, not capability paths) to cross-check the Modified Capabilities entries.

sources.quote: Use the exact existing path under openspec/specs/.

items.note: .openspec.yaml is not a declared artifact, so no kind can read its skip_specs key.

sources.quote: A change with no capabilities at all (pure refactor, tooling, docs) must set `skip_specs: true` in its .openspec.yaml - openspec validate rejects a zero-delta change without that marker.

unitemized.reason: This lets the field be empty (Leave empty if no requirement changes) instead of asking for content. Whether requirements change can't be observed by any predicate, so no none_allowed condition can be written for it.
